E2_operator_signature_invariance.why: gamma^mu_(-+++) = i gamma^mu_(+---) contributes i^2 = -1 while eta flips sign, so (J_5^I J_{5I}) — and every other contracted channel — is literally the same 4-index tensor in the two signatures. 'Signature-independent' is therefore a theorem, not a coincidence.

E3_single_species_relations.reading: each entry {X: c_X} means sum_X c_X O_X = 0 identically for ONE 4-component Grassmann Dirac field

E4_row_self_application.statement: O_A = 2 O_S + O_V - 2 O_P (single species), the fixed point of applying the derived row to its own A term

E5_poplawski_anchor.coefficient_identity: (3/16)*(16/9) = 1/3 exactly — the paper's 3/16 and Poplawski's 1/3 are the same number once his Eq.(9) colour factor is included, and they agree in SIGN only for scalar coefficient +1.

E6_Gs.scalar_coefficient: +1 (exact rational, both signatures, 3 reps, both gamma5 sign conventions)
